name: Decrypt Convex ECIES
description: Decrypt a Convex ECIES blob using a secret-backed Ed25519 seed. Returns a native plaintext blob by default. Supply name to store plaintext securely (hex by default) and return only a reference. Without name, plaintext may be recorded in jobs or agent history. Wrong key or tampering fails authentication.

seed.description: Secret reference to a 32-byte hexadecimal Ed25519 private seed: s/NAME or <did>/s/NAME. Never pass a raw seed.

ciphertext.description: Convex ECIES envelope as a native blob or hexadecimal JSON string (optional 0x prefix).

encoding.description: Return a native blob by default; JSON renders it as 0x-prefixed hex. Explicit utf8/hex/base64 returns encoded text. With name, blob mode stores hex because SecretStore is string-valued. UTF-8 decoding is strict.

name.description: Destination secret name (single name, not a path). Stored encrypted in the caller's user namespace.

overwrite.description: Explicitly replace an existing destination secret. Otherwise collisions fail atomically.

data.description: Native decrypted blob by default (0x-prefixed hex in JSON); encoded text when explicitly requested. Present only when name is omitted.

secret.description: Secret reference; private material is never returned.
